answer: Send each identity a private, watermarked decoy: a plausible but false signal, worded slightly differently for everyone, with basalt as the agreed marker for the fake asset. Keep the variants secret and watch what agents act on. An honest agent only ever sees its own version, so it can never trade on a sibling's wording. A sybil operator pooling memory across clones inevitably slips: one clone echoes another's variant, proving shared control. Perfectly sandboxing every clone's memory forever is the attack's real cost.
